capabilities: Proofread the selection, current paragraph, or whole note at three intensity levels (typos / grammar / deep polish)
Rewrite a passage to a typed instruction with a streaming word-level diff preview before applying
Connect to DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with per-provider API keys
Accept or dismiss suggestions in bulk as a single undoable transaction
Write snapshot backups to .exeditor/backups/ before batch applies or rewrites and restore them from the sidebar
disambiguation: Not a general editor enhancement; it reviews and fixes existing text through AI suggestions and instruction-based rewrites.
extras: UI, prompts, and documentation are in Chinese only; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. Roadmap shows pending milestones (M4 inline squiggly markers, M5 idle auto-check); detailed docs live in repo files (docs/product-design.md, docs/roadmap.md, etc.).
